text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Have you heard that urban legend

everyone's been talking about?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The one about the mysterious girl
who
follows you from inside your TV,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Once you make eye contact with her,
she keeps
staring at you even if you
change the channel...
At least, that's
what I heard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confused by the conversation I
overheard in the
hallway, I turn on the
TV to check the weather.

text_block_list.name: Weather Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It's looking like it'll be sunny throughout
today
and tomorrow in central Tokyo!
It's going to be
perfect weather to hang
up your laundry.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
This seafood ramen is incredible! It's no
wonder
the line for the shop stretches so
far!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A pair of big round eyes is staring at me
from the
edge of the screen. I think I
might know who that
spooky story is
about.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People have made an urban legend
about me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have to do something about this. I'm an

adorable mascot. I don't want people
thinking I'm
some kind of spooky
phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The answer's simple—it's part of my
promotional
campaign.
choice_data_list: Why are you trying to get on TV in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've got a sense for detecting places with
lots of
eyes on them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, if I go to those places and just so
happen to
get caught on camera, then
little by little I'll end
up being seen by
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I call it "Operation: Subliminal Machan"!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: At least... that was the plan. Sigh... But it hasn't really worked out the way I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, that girl everyone's been
talking
about showed up again! The girl
who saw her said
it's been seven days in
a row now!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, I heard... Whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! So, then—huh, where'd
you go?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was! Phew. That's a
relief...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
People were even talking about it in
class... Well,
I'll be sure to let everyone
know!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm sure you'll find out soon
enough.
choice_data_list: What have you been talking about this whole time?
What have you been talking about this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And that's why something nice will
happen if you
see her... She's like a
modern zashiki-warashi! You
know, a
spirit of good luck!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Really?! So if anything, I should be on
the lookout
for her!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I heard she shows up more often during
daytime
shows. Apparently, she wears an
outfit that looks
like our uniform too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, yes. I think this should do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I do? ...Maybe you're right.
choice_data_list: Didn't they seem pretty used to handling that...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mascots can set people's imaginations
going in all
kinds of directions. I'm glad
that fans find fun in
that, but at the
same time...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want my image to be pretty, so I'm
doing a little
course correction.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "They say she's nice after all." "She might actually bring us good luck?" "Let's see if we can find her."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, once they know my face...
"I've heard
her name's Machan!" And just
like that, I'd be
solidified in their
memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I intend to keep making
my cameos.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I intend to keep making
my cameos.
choice_data_list: Moving around quickly might be good training...?
You're really good at coming up with strategies!
You're really good at coming up with strategies!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
True. I hadn't thought of it that way. You
make a
good point!
choice_data_list: Moving around quickly might be good training...?
You're really good at coming up with strategies!
You're really good at coming up with strategies!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm glad you're so understanding,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Aston Machan's airy nature
makes her
hard to get a handle on, I
come to realize that her
mind is always
on the go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, strategizing is a crucial skill
for
anyone hoping to become an
international
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No plan, no thank you. But at the same
time,
there's no point overplanning
either. Let's just
take things niiice and
easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Aston Machan's airy nature
makes her
hard to get a handle on, I
come to realize that her
mind is always
on the go.
